title: Zabbix or Nagios: Picking an Open-Source Monitoring Platform
excerpt: Both are long-running open-source tools for monitoring servers, networks and services. Zabbix offers more out of the box; Nagios offers one of the largest plugin ecosystems in monitoring.
verdict: For most teams starting fresh, Zabbix is quicker to get going, with automatic discovery and built-in dashboards. Nagios is still a good choice if you already have a Nagios setup or rely on its vast collection of community plugins.
